calls.purpose: Baseline for later paired comparisons (prompts 0-63, seed 0, T=0.8, top-k 40), and material to test the hypothesis that sampled 4-gram loops are copies of earlier context (names/phrases) rather than tight cycles.

Test H1: at positions where the next token completes an already-seen 4-gram, the direct logit contribution to that token comes mainly from the weight-identified late copy heads (4.6, 5.0, 5.6, 5.1, 5.7), which there attend to the earlier occurrence; compare own generations with real stories.
